title: [CRY-15] Overclaim that media is bound to a DID through an SFU
description: Review finding CRY-15: Overclaim that media is bound to a DID through an SFU (lens CRY). Location: spec/06-calls.md:74, spec/06-calls.md:178, spec/06-calls.md:182. Fix: RFC 9605 §6.1.1 (rfc9605.txt:953-955) says: "in order to prevent impersonation by a malicious participant (not the SFU), a mechanism based on digital signature would be required. SFrame does not protect against such attacks". §7.2 says the same. 06:182 claims "Participant-to-participant binding is then provided by the SFrame keys", and 06:74 claims a stream is "cryptographically bound to their DID" without qualification. 06:412 already states the correct property for data channels. Restrict the DID binding to mesh DTLS-SRTP, and state group-only authentication for SFU media. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/06-calls.md §6.2 l72 DID binding limited to mesh ("through an SFU it does not"); §6.10 l250 SFU media authenticated only as group member per RFC 9605 §7.2; mesh-only claim at l246 is in mesh context
